title: AUTO RESOLUTION STOPS AT 75 PERCENT
why: His answer 2.44 b: the quality ladder may drop effects, but never picture sharpness below 75 percent. The auto step used to go down to 50 percent. Now it stops at 75 percent, in steps of 5.
now: Auto resolution never drops the picture under 75 percent.
